sentinelone_xdr_raw.dataset_description: SentinelOne Singularity is an AI-powered platform that protects endpoints, cloud workloads and identities from threats.

eventType.field_description: The event type of the SentinelOne record.

agentDetectionInfo.field_description: The SentinelOne agent and its host at detection time.

userId.field_description: The ID of the user who initiated the activity.
